title:
Findings respect the claim they were raised in: a finding carries the run
correlation id and the claim id (or batch id) it came from, so a client who
asks 'which close did this come from' gets an answer, not a guess. The claim is
closed after the finding is raised; nothing about the finding depends on the
claim booting after it. Acceptance: one finding, with run id and claim id
present in the exported artefact, and a test that fails when either id is
missing
